payload.summary: The council's news release of 4 December 2025, the day its budget consultation opened. It sets out the proposed 2.99% rise to the city council's share of council tax — "For an average Band D property, this would mean a rise from £306 to £315 per year", raising about £358,000 — and it states how a bill splits: "We currently receive 13p of every pound collected, with 73p going to Norfolk County Council and 14p to the Police and Crime Commissioner." It is the only page in this archive where the council writes that split down.
